setting.name: Migrate to Core Keys
setting.label: Migrate
setting.hint: Migrate Active Effect keys from the ATE syntax to core Foundry syntax introduced in v14.

app.title: Migrate
app.description: Migrate the world data (actors, items, and unlinked tokens on scenes) or compendium packs. Converts the active effect keys from the ATE syntax to the core Foundry syntax introduced in v14. For example: ATL.sight.range is changed to token.sight.range
app.warning: Backup your world or module data before migrating, just in case.

notifications.worldEnd: Migration of world data completed successfully. Updated {number} documents.
notifications.packEnd: Migration of {pack} compendium pack completed successfully. Updated {number} documents.
